review.reason: Issue #57 follow-up. The coefficients are printed as beta on pp. 4 and 6 (the PDF text layer reads the symbol as 'b'): verbatim test fields now hold only the printed t and p text, and each coefficient is a separate reported field written with beta and a minus sign. The printed morphology coefficient is no longer listed as missing in effects.json: a note points to program.json, where it is recorded, as does the context-by-morphology p value; they are not entered as numbers because the text layer drops the sign and exponent. The p value's evidence quote now contains it. SOURCE.json records the eScholarship URL and notes that the paper has no DOI. The adapter no longer clamps out-of-range ratings to 0 or 100 and no longer takes the first number from an ambiguous free-text reply: such replies are recorded as unparsed (None). List markers, a '/100' suffix and a sentence-final full stop are handled, with smoke-test cases for each.
